::: {.notes}
Published results checked 21 October 2026. These are sourced examples and reported measurements; no models were run for this deck.



Two original transparent product assets demonstrate glass, fine fibres and isolated alpha backgrounds.



- **Example output: 1024 × 1536 PNG **. Product-generation recipe; current code model name was migrated to 2.5. Attribution: output_characteristic. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/multimodal/transparent-image-assets-for-campaigns-and-presentations).

- **Background: Transparent alpha **. Source identifies original unchanged transparent PNGs; not a segmentation benchmark. Attribution: output_characteristic. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/multimodal/transparent-image-assets-for-campaigns-and-presentations).



**Example provenance and limitations.**

The setup note explicitly says the displayed images are retained from the original GPT Image 2 cookbook and are not measured GPT Image 2.5 results.

No numerical quality/preference score or timed evaluation is published for this example.

Original exact dated API snapshot is not stated. Do not label these assets 2.5.

The fictional product captions are not real product claims.
